claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of this package recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q) = z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P = infinity for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh algorithm coins (modelled 0.394, the floor of the claimed cap by construction at a 1.5x model-error allowance on the descent expectation: main phase >= 1 - 2^-190 over the Wiedemann projections, both boots within their measured bounds, Markov P(abort) <= 0.606 at the 2^120.58-unit descent cap with E = 2^119.272), under the disclosed NFS heuristics (H3's discriminant half verified exactly by integer-identity resultant certificates; the class-number half the standard disclosed hypothesis; smoothness heuristics at measured scope). A global meter bounds all classical work, including preprocessing, failures, transfers, storage, verification and output, by W <= 2^122.65 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; the ledger totals 2^122.6255, reproduced by the deterministic in-sandbox recompute: relation collection 2^121.9501 (B = 2^69, the descent plan's native factor base — LB = LX = 69, LOG2_RELS = 64.162 — with the native production region: the corrected coefficient-dilation law gives s* = 1, margin 0.3324 >= 0.3, no rescale; per-cell 461.28 instructions with the certified evaluator re-charged at C_NB_EVAL = 4,000 from a measured 3,974.3 Ir/evaluation under callgrind on linux/arm64, bit-identical survivor sets on all 2,401 pool rows), linear algebra 2^119.7003 (N = 2^59.5871 = pad 1.4 x N/U 0.049049 x U = 2^63.4513, the B = 2^69 factor base's column count — collector, matrix and descent plan share one factor base; the ratio is the three-seed 2^16..2^19 filtering sweep's 2^19 maximum; at the reference C_ENTRY = 96 and BW = 3), descent cap 2^120.58 (E = 2^119.272 at SLACK = 80, retention min 0.8591, worst node loss 1.83e-4, 3-sigma-inflated 1.85e-4; UDUP = 0.35 charged 1.9x below the worst 3-sigma lower bound 0.667 of twelve production-geometry re-measurements, worst run 0.7402 +- 0.073, mean 0.82), remaining components <= 2^90.3. Memory and storage follow the reference per-object bounded layout with priced transfers and injective 64-bit addressing (peak total storage <= 2^105 bytes, stated numerically in the note); nothing is amortised over future targets.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes in-sandbox the tower and H3 discriminant certificates and toy unit ranks, the pool, the measurement parse, the relation-collection ledger at the plan-native B = 2^69 with the corrected coefficient-dilation law (population s^6 with per-side norm shifts 36/6 x log2 s and the smoothness re-evaluated at the shifted sizes; s* = 1, margin 0.3324), the linear-algebra charge at the matching U = 2^63.4513 with a live filtsim spot-check, the exact bad-prime retention laws and loss integral, the descent expectation and cap, the success chain, and prints the total ledger 2^122.6255 with per-section PASS markers and a final JSON ledger line; the output's quoted_offline list states the in-sandbox versus quoted-offline evidence split.
